description: Rules pertaining to the madd badal. Madd badal occurs when a letter of madd is preceded by a hamzah in the same word. The letter of madd preceding the hamzah must be permanent (i.e. not caused by ibdāl).

madd_badal_qasr.title: Qaṣr on madd badal
madd_badal_qasr.description: All of the qurra, except Imam Warsh will only apply qaṣr on madd badal.

madd_badal_warsh.title: Qaṣr/Tawassuṭ/Ṭūl on madd badal
madd_badal_warsh.description: Imam Warsh has the option to apply qaṣr, tawassuṭ or ṭūl on madd badal subject to the following three conditions: • The letter before hamzah is not a sākin ṣaḥīḥ letter as in: قُرْءَانٌ, • The letter of madd is not temporary and the hamzah before it is not hamzat al-waṣl as in: إِيتُونِي • The alif after hamzah is not created through waqf bil ibdāl as in: نِسَاءَ
exceptions: The words يُؤَاخِذُ (along with all of its derivitives) and إِسْرَاءِيلَ will only be read with qaṣr. Some have also exempted the words عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ and ءَآلْـَٰٔنَ from the options of tawassuṭ/ṭūl of Imam Warsh
